summary.text: Abe Jones is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 38 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A lawyer and former Superior Court judge, he advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Abraham P. Jones, who is also known as Abe, earned an undergraduate degree from Harvard University in 1974 and a law degree from Harvard Law School in 1977.

His career includes work as a federal law clerk in Washington, D.C., an assistant U.S. attorney for the Eastern District of North Carolina, a private practice lawyer, an assistant attorney general, an administrative law judge, and owner of a law firm.
Governor James B. Hunt Jr. appointed Jones to the Superior Court in Wake County in August 1995, and he left the bench at the end of 2012 after losing a bid for re-election on November 6, 2012.
He assumed office in the state House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Yvonne Lewis Holley.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, and Judiciary I committees, among others.
